title: Thread claims
description: What one worker asserts, each claim carrying the verbatim span that makes stage 05's 'read before you label' rule mechanically checkable rather than a matter of judgement.

id.description: claim- + sha256("<package_id>:<normalised text>")[:16] — the rule already used by build-graph.sh and detect-contradictions.sh (change-rah-010), reused rather than reinvented.

quote.description: Verbatim, at most 40 words, and present in the named chunk. The word cap is enforced by the validator, which JSON Schema cannot express.
